basic_profile.bio: I'm a 23-year-old who recently got into Minecraft and am exploring the vast world of Reddit. I live in Seattle and work as a junior software developer. My interests include gaming, particularly Minecraft, and learning about new tech trends. I'm single and often spend my evenings and weekends diving into online games and tech forums. I enjoy connecting with others over shared interests, though I'm still figuring out the intricacies of Reddit. I usually browse Reddit after work, from around 6 PM to midnight PST.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in Computer Science and have been dabbling in programming since high school. I learned a lot through online courses and tutorials, especially in web development and software engineering. I've recently started exploring game development, inspired by my passion for Minecraft.
